signal: Trunk Tools closed a $40M Series B led by Insight Partners and is expanding from point tools into an integrated construction AI platform

email.subject1: a signal play for Trunk Tools
email.body1:
Boris, saw Trunk Tools closed a $40M Series B with Insight Partners and is moving from point tools to a full construction AI platform.

That usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Trunk Tools off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Boris, quick follow-up for Trunk Tools.

Post-Series B, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Trunk Tools needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Boris, last bit of proof for Trunk Tools.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trunk Tools' reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Boris, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The fundraise-to-platform stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything right after a raise.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I will tailor it to Trunk Tools either way.
